      - name: Build staging variant into dist/staging
        env:
          VITE_GAS_ENDPOINT: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxjBvowI9VBP4wIn_OpGolXW-pVZxKhigby68gGuplNGdyYPcn9GEcFYZhPzGJ9ipJK/exec"
          VITE_MUSIC_GAS_ENDPOINT: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxy4MH-lBmB5DYHk_Gcijqf-lJHV4kt24qKUCq7eH2c99kIYlxPjhMGh8PfvZs1wT6O/exec"
          VITE_STAGING: "1"
        run: |
          npm run build:staging
          mkdir -p dist/staging
          cp -r dist-staging/* dist/staging/
